Funda eGameni leNkosi yakho okuyiyona eyadala.
Funda, belu iNkosi yakho iphana kakhulu.
Kumbeke egqugquzelela ukuzithoba ku Allah na?
Uke wambona lapho esephika iqiniso futhi elishaya indiva.
Ingabe ngempela akazi yini ukuthi u Allah Uyabona na?
Qha! Ungamlaleli, kepha ukhothame [ku Allah] ukhonze.
